sources.citation: Supplement of Berg et al. (2024), doi:10.5194/acp-24-13715-2024-supplement, Table S1.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0; cover notes individual parts may have different copyright. Table S1 contains this study's original measurements.

locations: Complete Table S1 caption, two canister columns, units and all fourteen methane measurements; adjacent tables inspected to avoid wrong-species transcription

audited_observation_sets.quantitative_readiness_scope: Descriptive central bimolecular coefficient only, not experimental confidence or method applicability.
audited_observation_sets.observable: Absolute bimolecular OH-loss coefficient k_OH+CH4, after subtraction of the measured instrumental zero-decay coefficient; not the pseudo-first-order decay coefficient in s^-1.
audited_observation_sets.source_location: Supplement Table S1, printed page 1 (PDF page 2); main Eq. 2 and uncertainty paragraph, printed page 13718 (PDF page 4); methane mixing ratio, printed page 13720 (PDF page 6); main Table 1, printed page 13721 (PDF page 7).

source_conditions.pressure_provenance: Main Table 1 This work row explicitly reports 1000 hPa. The abstract's 1 atm is retained as approximate wording, not replaced by 1013.25 hPa.
source_conditions.bath_gas: humidified synthetic air prepared from nitrogen and oxygen
source_conditions.methane_concentration_measurement: Picarro G2401 cavity ring-down spectroscopy; methane was not quantified by the TOC method
source_conditions.lowest_temperature_humidity_note: Methods report 0.8% at the nominal 280 K setpoint. S1's lowest actual methane temperatures are 286.0 and 284.4 K; no per-point humidity is tabulated, so a unique exact humidity is not assigned to those rows.
source_conditions.initial_OH_density_qualifier: generic methods value, not a per-point measurement
source_conditions.OH_production: 266 nm ozone flash photolysis followed by O(1D)+H2O; 20 mJ pulses at 1 Hz
source_conditions.OH_detection: 308 nm LIF in a separate downstream cell at 3.5 hPa; this is not the reaction pressure

rate_convention.normalization_basis: Molecular number density: Eq. 2 divides a first-order OH decay coefficient by reactant number density. The implicit per-molecule convention is made explicit, not converted from molar units.
rate_convention.observable_equation: -d[OH]/dt = k_OH+CH4 [OH][CH4] for the methane-dependent loss component

primary_comparator_selection.rule: First original Table S1 methane row in the first original canister column. Preserve all fourteen rows; do not average, select by prediction agreement, round the measured temperature or evaluate the fitted Arrhenius expression.

reference_uncertainty.interpretation: S1 prints per-point plus/minus values without a sigma definition in its caption. Do not assign the main-table 2-sigma caption to S1. Methods state 12% 2-sigma methane accuracy; Table 1's printed 6.1+/-1.0 corresponds to about 16.4%, not 12%. Preserve both, do not repair or choose the smaller uncertainty, and do not claim exact coverage or independent-point calibration.

conditions.added_bath_gas: Synthetic air (N2/O2 exact ratio unreported); approximately 1.3% H2O; O3 20-50 ppbv.

limitations: Experimental finite-pressure coefficient at nominal 1000 hPa, not a measured high-pressure limiting rate or proof of pressure independence. Reaction pressure is not the 3.5 hPa detector or 350 kPa preparation-canister pressure.

Exact N2/O2 ratio, per-point pressure and composition uncertainties, raw fluorescence curves and a shared systematic covariance matrix are not given here. Nominal reported composition is not silently completed with air fractions or ozone midpoint.
The paper discusses impurities and does not exclude a larger influence from highly reactive trace contaminants; published accuracy is not an independently verified bound on all errors.
S1 point errors are not total calibrated confidence intervals; Table 1 and methods accuracy differ. These are retained observations, not zero uncertainty or a tuned acceptance tolerance.

OH+CH4 is chemically plausible for the existing conventional gas TS/frequency/IRC and Arkane boundary. No independent atom-mapped candidate, verified stationary points, rate, total path degeneracy or method applicability has been produced for this case.

A gas high-pressure TST result cannot be renamed as this finite-pressure measured coefficient without a retained applicability argument. H-transfer tunneling, OH electronic-state statistical weights, symmetry-equivalent total loss rather than a per-H path, recrossing and model accuracy remain unresolved.

No reference product identity, expected route, fitted Arrhenius coefficients or source evidence may be exported as production input. No parent lifetime, product distribution, full flow-tube chemistry or elementary-mechanism ground truth is scored.

One proposed scalar panel comparator does not validate the fourteen-point temperature dependence. All measurements remain frozen together as one source study, not fourteen independent validation cases.
No chemistry execution budget, acceptance threshold, prospective holdout, supported-network claim or uncertainty calibration is created.

amendment_policy: Unapplied proposal only. Preserve source bytes and all fourteen points. A correction requires a new dated audit with predecessor hashes; never adjust reference selection or uncertainty after a prediction.
